description: QR code generator: black-on-white canvas with quiet zone, author children kept as the caption

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The text/URL to encode. Falls back to the element's original text content. Reactive; removing it falls back to the text again.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Edge of the drawn box in CSS pixels, quiet zone included. Modules are a whole number of device pixels. Reactive.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Module colour (any CSS colour). Opt-in; logs a console warning when the pair is inverted, low-contrast or translucent. Reactive.

attributes.name: background
attributes.description: Background colour, always painted, including the 4-module quiet zone. Reactive.

attributes.name: error-correction
attributes.description: Error-correction level: L (7%), M (15%, default), Q (25%), H (30%), or 0-3. Letters are case-insensitive (listed lower-case because html-validate matches enums lower-cased); other values warn and use M. Reactive.

attributes.name: data-caption
attributes.description: Show the caption (the element's children) under the code. By default it is visually hidden but read by screen readers, and shown while a link inside it has focus.

attributes.name: data-label-prefix
attributes.description: Accessible name of the canvas (role=img). The value itself is read from the caption, so it is not announced twice.

attributes.name: data-error
attributes.description: Set when no code could be drawn (the text is longer than the level holds, or cannot be encoded). The caption is then shown.

events.name: qr-code:error
events.description: Fired when the value cannot be encoded. No code is drawn and the caption (fallback) stays visible.

events.name: qr-code:upgraded
events.description: Fired once the element has upgraded (canvas and caption in place).

properties.name: value
properties.description: The encoded text. Setting it sets the value attribute; '' or null removes it.

methods.name: toDataURL(type?)
methods.description: Returns the code as a data URL (default image/png): opaque, quiet zone included. '' when no code is drawn.

methods.name: copy(options?)
methods.description: Copies the code to the clipboard as text/plain (the encoded value) + image/png. Falls back to text-only without ClipboardItem support. options.button gets data-state="copied" and a copy event. Resolves false when no code is drawn.
